purpose: run-to-run spread of the No memory baseline, so Table III reports No memory and MAVRA both as means of three runs
settings_check: run.json settings of run 1 (call/validation caps, patience, sample, LightGBM parameters, model, reasoning effort) equal the current harness; the first new sessions' system prompt and tools are compared with run 1 before the runs are kept
paper_row: No memory row = mean of runs 1-3; token ratios of every method relative to that mean; range of each task mean stated in the text
no_selection: both new runs are reported whatever their scores
concurrency: run alongside the four v10 cells (up to eight cells); memory headroom checked
budget_guard: one guard over v10 and these cells
